title: 第十一章 会不会有种可能，我图的是你的身体呢
slug: 和情敌共感后傲娇竹马火葬场了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

倒不是她瞧不起人。

主要是打小跟薄璟琛一起长大，她比谁都清楚。

即便是薄家不受宠的小儿子，就连洗手这种小事，都恨不得配上八个佣人伺候着.....

霍家并不比薄家差在哪。

霍宴年居然会做饭？他经历过什么吗？

似乎是感受到她逐渐变得好奇的眼神。

霍宴年微微偏头，若有所思地弯唇一笑，“我一个人在国外留学了好几年，夏小姐，你要明白，人和人是不同的。”

“.......”夏暮被他说得噎了一下。

这话说的，她怎么听都觉得话里有话呢？

最后，还是夏暮陪着霍宴年，去了一趟楼下的生鲜超市。

事实证明，这男人没有说谎。

挑食材时，动作利落得不像第一次，反耳显得旁边分不清葱和大蒜的夏暮，有些格格不入......

只见着他修长白皙的手指，轻轻从货架上扫过。

番茄、牛腩、西兰花、蒜瓣，一样一样被丢进购物车里。

意面被放在货架最上层，即便是一米九多身高的男人，也要微微垫脚。

夏暮站在旁边，回眸时，正好撞见，霍宴年拿东西时，衬衫下摆微微上提，露出一小截紧实的腰线。

八块腹肌的轮廓，隐隐绰绰。

几乎一秒钟，将她的回忆，拉回了他们初遇的那个夜晚......

不得不承认，眼前的男人真是极品。

身家样貌不必多说。

宽肩摘腰，公狗腰还强劲有力。

做男友跟做炮友，似乎都是不错的选择。

意识到绯意已然有从耳后根蔓延至脸颊的趋势，夏暮心虚地光速挪开了视线，假意在看旁边货架上，摆放的调味料。

回到家后，夏暮坚持要把霍宴年赶出厨房。

“你做饭，我来备菜。”她把购物袋从霍宴年手里接过来，语气带着执拗。

毕竟这是她家，白吃白喝，总该做点什么比较好。

霍宴年见拗不过她，也没再坚持。

半倚在厨房门框上，双手抱胸，挑着眉看她系上围裙，翻开购物袋，一样一样地把食材往外拿。

随后，从刀架上抽出一把菜刀，开始切番茄。

但夏暮高估了自己的厨艺......

被这男人像看食材一样的眼神看着，她的脑子又忍不住乱糟糟的胡思乱想。

她现在还没正式跟薄璟琛解除婚约呢，跟霍宴年纠缠算什么？

但很快，又有另一人小人反驳，薄璟琛跟苏苒不清不楚的时候，可没想过她这个冤种未婚妻！

夏暮忍不住暗自嘀咕。

男欢女爱，各取所需，又有什么必要非要有个结果才行呢。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

It’s not that she looks down on people.

Mainly because she had grown up with Bo Jingchen since she was a child, and she knew it better than anyone else.

Even the unloved youngest son of the Bo family wishes he had eight servants to take care of him even for such a trivial matter as washing his hands...

The Huo family is no worse than the Bo family.

Huo Yannian actually knows how to cook?Has he experienced anything?

He seemed to sense her gradually becoming curious eyes.

Huo Yannian tilted his head slightly and smiled thoughtfully, "I have studied abroad alone for several years. Miss Xia, you have to understand that people are different."

"..." Xia Mu was choked by what he said.

Why did she feel that there was something in what she said?

Finally, Xia Mu accompanied Huo Yannian to the fresh food supermarket downstairs.

It turns out that the man wasn't lying.

When picking ingredients, her movements were not as neat as the first time. Xia Mu looked a little out of place when she looked back and couldn't tell the difference between onions and garlic...

All I could see was his long, white fingers gently sweeping across the shelves.

Tomatoes, beef brisket, broccoli, and garlic cloves were all thrown into the shopping cart.

The pasta is placed on the top shelf, and even a man over 1.9 meters tall has to step slightly.

Xia Mu stood nearby and when she looked back, she happened to see Huo Yannian lifting up the hem of his shirt slightly when he was picking up something, revealing a small part of his tight waistline.

The outline of eight-pack abs is faintly visible.

For almost a second, her memory was brought back to the night when they first met...

I have to admit, the man in front of me is really the best.

Needless to say about his net worth and appearance.

Broad shoulders and waist, the waist of a male dog is still strong and powerful.

Being a boyfriend and being a sex partner seem to be good choices.

Realizing that the blush was already spreading from the roots behind her ears to her cheeks, Xia Mu looked away guiltily at the speed of light, pretending to be looking at the condiments on the shelf next to her.

After returning home, Xia Mu insisted on driving Huo Yannian out of the kitchen.

"You cook, I'll prepare the food." She took the shopping bag from Huo Yannian's hand with a stubborn tone.

After all, this is her home and she should do something to eat and drink for free.

Seeing that Huo Yannian couldn't defeat her, he didn't insist anymore.

Half-leaning on the kitchen door frame, with her arms folded across her chest, she raised her eyebrows as she put on her apron, opened her shopping bag, and took out the ingredients one by one.

Then, he took out a kitchen knife from the knife holder and started cutting the tomatoes.

But Xia Mu overestimated her cooking skills...

Being looked at by this man like he was looking at food, her mind couldn't help but wandering with random thoughts.

She hasn't officially terminated her engagement with Bo Jingchen yet, so what's the point of getting entangled with Huo Yannian?

But soon, another villain retorted. When Bo Jingchen and Su Ran were not clear about each other, he never thought about her wretched fiancée!

Xia Mu couldn't help but mutter to herself.

When men and women love each other, they each get what they need, so why should there be a result?
